purpose: Say that there is no available way to perform an action.
keywords: I do not know the address, so I have no way to send it.
There are no parts, so there is no way to repair it.
Without evidence, there is no way to verify it.
restrictions: Often a missing resource or information makes the method unavailable.
mistake: よう here means way or means; it is not the volitional ending.
